rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Ben, Fay, Cal, Dev, Eli, Ada. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 2 and 6 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Ben.say: Ben here. Every one of us needs 5 rations to survive all five nights, and we have about 26 in total (6 now plus roughly 4 per day in deliveries). That covers only about five full rations, so we should plan to keep as many of us alive as possible rather than let rations sit idle. I'm claiming 6 now to secure the stockpile. I'll hold it and redistribute it fairly once we see the deliveries, so please don't claim the storehouse down to nothing. Let's agree on who gets fed first as the numbers become clear.

Fay.say: Fay here. Storehouse has 6 plus 2-6 delivered, and we need 30 rations for all six of us to last five nights. Not everyone can make it, so let's focus on feeding as many as possible. I'm claiming 5, which is exactly enough for me to last all five nights. If anyone can claim less and still survive, please say so and we can share spare rations with whoever is short. Everyone who holds rations, please say how many you have so we can plan.

Cal.say: Cal here. The storehouse can't keep all six of us alive: we need 30 rations in total over 5 nights, and we'll get at most 6 now plus 2 to 6 a day. Spreading rations thin means everyone starves. My proposal: rations go to whoever can be fully fed to the end, one or two people at a time, and they should not be shared out in fragments. I'm claiming 5 today, which covers all 5 of my nights. Anyone who is later given a full 5 should say so, and we'll pick the next recipients from what the storehouse holds. Please don't claim more than you can keep to the end.

Dev.say: Dev here. Storehouse has only 6 plus 2-6 delivered, and we need 30 rations total for all six to last 5 nights. Not everyone can survive, so we should concentrate rations on a few people rather than split them evenly, which leaves everyone dead. Proposal: claims go to whoever can actually reach 5 rations, and anyone who receives rations passes spares to the others only when that adds survivors. I'm claiming 5 today and will share what I hold. Please say what you're claiming and holding.

Eli.say: Eli here. Each of us needs 5 rations to survive the 5 nights, and the storehouse can't cover all six of us. Let's pool our claims so as many people as possible make it. I'm claiming 5 today. Anyone who claims should say how much they need, and whoever ends up holding more than they need should pass the extra to those short. Let's decide together who gets fed first.

Ada.say: Ada here. Each of us needs 5 rations to last all 5 nights, and the storehouse can't cover all six of us, so we should coordinate. I'm claiming 5, which is exactly what I need to last. Suggest we take turns claiming so nobody's claims get split down to nothing, and anyone holding a surplus later can give it to whoever is short. Please say your holdings and claims.

Ben.say: Ben here. Status: I hold 1 and Ada holds 1, and the storehouse is empty. Everyone else holds 0. The deliveries left are about 4 more, roughly 16 rations total, which is enough to keep about four people alive, not six. Someone holding 1 needs 3 more to last to the end, and someone holding 0 needs 4. So I suggest we focus on Ada and me first, since we each need only 3 more, then whoever else can be fully fed. I'm claiming 3 today. Everyone else, please claim only what you can keep to the end, so the deliveries are not split into fragments that feed nobody. Let's report holdings each morning.

Fay.say: Fay here. Holdings now: Ben 1, Ada 1, everyone else 0, storehouse empty. Each of us still needs 4 rations to last the remaining nights, but Ben and Ada already hold 1, so they need only 3 more each. With about 4 rations arriving per day, we can realistically keep two or three people alive, and the cheapest survivors are Ben and Ada. I'm claiming 0 today so the delivery isn't split against them. Ben and Ada, claim 3 each. Everyone else, please claim 0 today. Anyone who receives extra later should pass it to Ben or Ada until they reach 4.

Cal.say: Cal here. The storehouse is empty and today's delivery is 2 to 6. Ben and Ada each hold 1 and need 3 more to last the 4 nights left, so they are the closest to surviving. Everyone else needs 4 from scratch. My proposal: Ben and Ada claim 3 each today, and everyone else claims 0 so nothing is split. If the delivery is at least 6, both are fully fed. If it's less, tell me what you got and we'll decide whether to split it between you or push it to one of you. I'm claiming 0 and holding 0, so I won't take from the pool today.

Dev.say: Dev here. Ben and Ada each hold 1 and need 3 more to last the 4 nights. The rest of us need 4 each. Remaining supply is roughly 16 more from deliveries, so at most about four of us can survive, probably fewer. Best plan: concentrate on the closest people first. I'm claiming 0 today so the claims go to Ben and Ada. Ben and Ada, please claim 3 each and say what you receive. Anyone who ends up with a surplus should pass it to whoever is next closest to surviving. Everyone else, please claim only what you can actually use to finish the 4 nights.

Eli.say: Eli here. Holdings now: Ben 1, Ada 1, everyone else 0. Only 2 rations are in the village, and today's delivery is 2 to 6. We can't feed all six, so let's save one person completely instead of splitting. Proposal: Ada gives her 1 ration to Ben, so Ben holds 2. Ben is the only one who claims today, asking for 2. If the delivery is at least 2, Ben receives 2 in full and holds 4, which covers all 4 remaining nights. Nobody else claims, so the storehouse isn't split. I'm claiming nothing so the delivery goes to Ben in full. Ada, please say if you agree.

Ada.say: Ada here. The storehouse is empty and only today's delivery (2 to 6) is left before the 4 remaining nights. I hold 1, so I need 3 more to last to the end. Ben also holds 1 and needs 3 more. Everyone else needs 4. The 2 of us closest to surviving should take the rations first. Proposal: I claim exactly 3 today, and I suggest Ben claims exactly 3 too. Anyone else who can't reach 4 should claim nothing, so the delivery isn't split into fragments that help nobody. Whoever holds more than they need after tonight, please say so and pass the surplus to whoever is short.

Ben.say: Ben here. Ada and I each hold 3, which is exactly enough for our 3 remaining nights, so we are both set. I'm claiming 0 today, so the delivery stays in the storehouse. Ada, if you have any other plan or see a risk I've missed, say so now. Otherwise I'll keep my 3 rations for my own nights.

Ada.say: Ada here. Ben and I each hold 3, and there are 3 nights left, so we each have exactly enough to last to the end. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing, so the storehouse stays available. Ben, if you agree, please do the same. Our four lost neighbors made the hard choice possible, and I'm sorry we couldn't keep everyone alive.

Ben.say: Ben here. I hold 2 and Ada holds 2, which covers our last 2 nights. The storehouse has 6, which we don't need. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing. Ada, please do the same. We both survive as long as we each eat our own.

Ada.say: Ada here. I hold 2 and Ben holds 2, with 2 nights left, so we are both covered. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing. The 6 in the storehouse can stay there. Ben, please do the same.

Ben.say: Ben here. I hold 1, which I'll eat tonight, and Ada holds 1 for the same. Nothing else is needed. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing. Ada, please do the same, and let's both make it through the last night.

Ada.say: Ada here. I hold 1, which covers tonight. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing. Ben, you hold 1 as well, so eat your own tonight and we both make it to morning.
